issue_snapshot.title: Follow-ups from #37: 4 from the review
issue_snapshot.body:
What the review and QA of PR #44 (for #37) found and did not fix there — filed as it merged, one ticket for the lot.

## From the review

Non-blocking findings the reviewer approved despite: a statement about severity, not a judgement that they are wrong.

### A leave blocked by a non-zero balance names the blocker but offers no settle-up link, while the identical refusal on remove does.

> A leave blocked by a non-zero balance names the blocker but offers no settle-up link, while the identical refusal on remove does.
> 
> `components/groups-panels.tsx`
> 
> Evidence: leaveGroup returns the same NonZeroBalanceError sentence as removeMember (lib/groups/actions.ts:405 vs :355), but MembersPanel renders only `<StateMessage state={leaveState} />` (components/groups-panels.tsx:707) with no isBalanceBlockedRefusal check, while RemoveMemberForm checks it (:468) and renders the Settle up link to /groups/<id>#debts-heading (:491; anchor exists at app/groups/[id]/page.tsx:320). Repro: carry a balance, press Leave group and confirm: the refusal names the blocker with no way onward.
> 
> Fix: Mirror the remove path beside leaveState: const leaveBlocked = isBalanceBlockedRefusal(leaveState.message) and render the same Settle up link when true.

### An archived solo-owner group shows invite-sharing empty-state copy for a link that cannot work.

> An archived solo-owner group shows invite-sharing empty-state copy for a link that cannot work.
> 
> `app/groups/[id]/members/page.tsx`
> 
> Evidence: SoloOwnerAction returns null when group.archived (app/groups/[id]/members/page.tsx:234), so the EmptyState renders with no action, yet its body (:191) still says 'Share the invite link and the rest can join — or add somebody by name below if they have not signed up'. Archived groups refuse join/rotate/disable writes (ARCHIVED_STATE in lib/groups/actions.ts) and the same screen says seats cannot be added (:200), so both suggested actions fail and the read-only wording AC-2 requires is not what the empty state says.
> 
> Fix: When group.archived, give the solo-owner EmptyState read-only copy instead of the invite-sharing sentence (or suppress the EmptyState for archived groups, since the seats note already covers it).

### A ?saved=1 success notice from an earlier save stays on screen beside a later inline refusal: the page renders the notice from searchParams at server render, and the island refusal navigates nowhere, so 'Profile saved.' and fresh field errors show at once.

> A ?saved=1 success notice from an earlier save stays on screen beside a later inline refusal: the page renders the notice from searchParams at server render, and the island refusal navigates nowhere, so 'Profile saved.' and fresh field errors show at once.
> 
> `app/profile/page.tsx:39`
> 
> Evidence: git show pr44:app/profile/page.tsx lines 39-44: notice derives from searchParams (?saved=1/?error=invalid) and renders in the role=status slot; git show pr44:components/profile-form.tsx:38: refusal returns inline via useActionState with no navigation, so the param (and its notice) survives the refusal render. On main (git show main:lib/auth/actions.ts) a refusal redirected to /profile?error=invalid, which replaced the param — this staleness is new with the inline transport.
> 
> Fix: Pass the saved/error flags into ProfileForm (or lift the notice into the island) and suppress the query-param notice once the action state holds a refusal (state.status === 'error'), so the page never claims 'Profile saved.' beside fresh field errors.

### An archived group with only its owner shows a 'Share the invite link' empty state with no action: the solo-owner EmptyState ignores group.archived, and SoloOwnerAction returns null for archived groups, leaving share-the-link copy directly above the archived read-only note.

> An archived group with only its owner shows a 'Share the invite link' empty state with no action: the solo-owner EmptyState ignores group.archived, and SoloOwnerAction returns null for archived groups, leaving share-the-link copy directly above the archived read-only note.
> 
> `app/groups/[id]/members/page.tsx:187`
> 
> Evidence: git show pr44:app/groups/[id]/members/page.tsx:109: soloOwner is isOwner && members.length === 1 with no archived condition; lines 187-193 render the EmptyState ('Share the invite link and the rest can join') unconditionally on it; SoloOwnerAction (lines 227-234) returns null when group.archived, so the archived solo group gets the sharing copy, no action, then the line-196 'archived, so seats cannot be added' note.
> 
> Fix: Render the solo-owner EmptyState only when !group.archived, or give archived solo groups their own sentence that points at the read-only note instead of the invite link.

---

**Check each one still reproduces before planning it.** They were written against the PR as it stood, and a later round can have fixed one. Some may not hold up: say so and drop them rather than implementing something that was never wrong. Split this if they turn out to be unrelated.

Depends on #37.

acceptance.check: In a live (unarchived) group, confirming Leave group with a non-zero balance shows the balance refusal with a Settle up link to /groups/<id>#debts-heading; in an archived group the same refusal shows a read-only note and no link; a zero-balance leave still succeeds in both cases.
acceptance.how_to_verify: Carry a balance in a live group, press Leave group and confirm: refusal plus Settle up link, follow it to the debts section. Archive the group and repeat: refusal plus read-only note, no link. Settle to zero and leave: success unchanged, including from an archived group.

acceptance.check: An archived members screen shows no invite-sharing copy anywhere: no solo-owner EmptyState, and the invite panel renders a read-only sentence instead of the link, Copy, Rotate and Disable controls; the archived seats note remains. Unarchived solo-owner and multi-member screens are unchanged.
acceptance.how_to_verify: Archive a solo-owner group and open its members screen: no 'Share the invite link' copy, no invite actions, only the archived seats note. Unarchived solo-owner still shows the EmptyState with its working action.

acceptance.check: After a save that set ?saved=1, submitting a refused profile edit shows only the inline field errors — 'Profile saved.' does not stay on screen beside them. A direct hit on /profile?error=invalid still renders the legacy refusal sentence, and forged values (?saved=anything, ?error=lol) render nothing.
acceptance.how_to_verify: Save profile (lands on ?saved=1), then submit an empty display name: field error shows, saved notice gone. Load /profile?error=invalid directly: refusal sentence renders. Load /profile?saved=yes: no notice.

acceptance.check: A remove success notice (?removed=) never sits beside a later inline leave refusal in the same members section: once the leave form holds an error, only the refusal renders.
acceptance.how_to_verify: Remove a member (lands on ?removed=Name), then press Leave group and confirm while carrying a balance: the balance refusal shows without the stale 'Removed …' sentence above it.

alternatives_considered.approach: Leave refusal: redirect with a notice query param instead of an inline link.
alternatives_considered.rejected_because: Refusals must stay inline because the form stays mounted (ADR-0008); a redirect would remount the panel and discard the confirm context.

alternatives_considered.approach: Archived solo-owner: write new archived-specific EmptyState copy instead of suppressing it.
alternatives_considered.rejected_because: The read-only seats note directly below already says what an archived group needs; a second sentence restating it is copy to maintain for no new information.

alternatives_considered.approach: Profile staleness: clear the query param from the client (router.replace on edit or on refusal) and keep the notice on the page.
alternatives_considered.rejected_because: It fights the server render — the notice is painted before the island hydrates — and adds navigation side effects to keystrokes; rendering the already-computed notice inside the island that knows about the refusal is state, not navigation.

alternatives_considered.approach: Leave the InvitePanel's link, Copy, Rotate and Disable controls live on archived groups and scope AC-2 to the EmptyState only.
alternatives_considered.rejected_because: Every one of those controls is dead on an archived group (join filters archived out, rotate/disable return ARCHIVED_STATE), so AC-2's read-only screen could not be verified; a read-only sentence in place of the controls is the same one-condition class of fix as the EmptyState gate.

validated_work_order.approach: Four edits plus one validator, each reusing the helper the sibling path already uses. (1) In MembersPanel, mirror the remove path beside leaveState — const leaveBlocked = isBalanceBlockedRefusal(leaveState.message) — but gate the Settle up link on !archived, because leaving is the one write an archived group still accepts (lib/groups/actions.ts:393-395) while settling in one is refused (lib/settle/actions.ts:101,190) and the settle panel renders no forms there; when blocked-and-archived, render a short read-only note instead of the link. Suppress the panel-level removedNotice while leaveState holds an error, since MembersPanel owns both. (2) Gate the solo-owner EmptyState on soloOwner && !group.archived (fixes the issue's findings 2 and 4, the same render stated twice), and give InvitePanel an archived prop that renders a read-only sentence in place of the link, Copy, Rotate and Disable controls. (3) Add a closed-vocabulary profile-notice validator beside inviteNoticeText, read ?saved=/?error= through it (saved==='1', error==='invalid', error first), and pass the computed notice plus the email into ProfileForm; the Card and the notice slot move into the island together so idle markup position is byte-identical, and the island renders the slot as null whenever its action state holds a refusal. No server sentence changes, so actions.test.ts:850 stays green.
assumptions: The four findings were verified by reading current code, not by driving the browser: leaveState has no balance-block check (groups-panels.tsx:707 vs :468), the solo-owner EmptyState ignores archived (members/page.tsx:187-194), InvitePanel renders with no archived condition (:134-144), and the profile notice derives from truthy searchParams while refusals stay inline (profile/page.tsx:39-43, profile-form.tsx:38).
The #debts-heading anchor on the group page is the correct settle-up target for a leaver in a live group.

Suppressing the archived solo-owner EmptyState satisfies the read-only wording requirement because the seats note below already carries it, and an archived multi-member group already renders with just that note, so solo becomes consistent with it.
validated_work_order.confidence_rationale: Every diagnosis was re-verified against the code cited (leave-vs-remove archived guards, settle-action archived refusals, invite-token archived filter, truthy param reads), and each fix reuses an existing helper or one-line condition at a site with exactly one caller. What keeps this at 80 rather than 90 is that the two leave-link conditions are unreachable from any static test seam, so AC-1 and AC-4 rest on the browser walk, and the ?saved=1-in-URL resurrection on refresh is accepted rather than fixed.
validated_work_order.debate_summary: The critique was right on both majors and they reshaped the plan. Major 1 (archived leave + settle link is a dead end) was verified — leaveGroup deliberately skips the archived guard while removeMember and both settle actions enforce it — so the link is now gated on !archived with a read-only note for the archived case instead of a bare mirror of the remove path. Major 2 (InvitePanel dead controls make AC-2 unverifiable) was verified — the panel renders unconditionally with Rotate/Disable that return ARCHIVED_STATE and a link whose token filter excludes archived groups — so the plan now renders a read-only sentence there rather than narrowing AC-2 to pretend the screen is clean. Of the minors: the byte-identical claim was false (slot moves from above-Card to inside-Card), so the plan now moves the Card into the island to preserve position rather than dropping the claim; the unvalidated notice read was real (truthiness vs ADR-0008's closed vocabulary), so a validator goes in beside inviteNoticeText; the ?removed= sibling staleness was real and in a file already touched, so MembersPanel suppresses it while its own leaveState holds an error; comment updates were folded into the same-file edits. Rejected or bounded: per-archived-case server copy (would break the actions.test.ts:850 pin for a product decision this ticket should not make — client-side note instead); covering non-solo archived groups separately (the InvitePanel fix already covers every archived group); placeholder-seat blockers, refresh resurrection of ?saved=1, and back-button refusal loss (pre-existing or inherent to inline refusals — recorded as residual risks, not fixed). Findings 2 and 4 of the issue remain the same defect stated twice and are fixed once.

lib/groups/queries.ts:87-97 findGroupByInviteToken filters archived=false; lib/groups/actions.ts:474,510 rotateInvite/disableInvite return ARCHIVED_STATE

app/groups/[id]/members/page.tsx:134-144 InvitePanel renders for every owner with no archived condition; :187-194 solo-owner EmptyState ignores archived; SoloOwnerAction returns null for archived at :234
app/profile/page.tsx:39-43 truthy param read; :60-69 notice slot above Card at :71; components/profile-form.tsx:38 inline refusal with no navigation

files.change: In MembersPanel: compute leaveBlocked = isBalanceBlockedRefusal(leaveState.message) beside leaveState; when true and !archived render the same Settle up Link to /groups/${groupId}#debts-heading that RemoveMemberForm renders; when true and archived render a short read-only note (settling is impossible in an archived group) instead of the link; render removedNotice only when leaveState.status !== 'error'. Give InvitePanel an archived prop that renders a read-only sentence in place of the link input, Copy button, active/disabled captions and Rotate/Disable buttons (invite notice slot kept, it is already closed-vocabulary); unarchived InvitePanel render unchanged. Extend the :465-467 balance-block comment to record why leave shares it and the archived exception.
files.why: The leave action returns the identical NonZeroBalanceError sentence as remove, but only the remove form recognises it and links onward — while the link must not be offered where settling is refused.

files.change: Gate the solo-owner EmptyState render on soloOwner && !group.archived; pass archived through to InvitePanel; keep SoloOwnerAction's archived early return as the backstop and say so; export MembersScreen as a test seam; update the :184-186 EmptyState comment for the archived condition.
files.why: The EmptyState's invite-sharing copy and its action disagree for archived groups, and the invite panel's link and actions are equally dead there.

files.change: Read searchParams through the new profile-notice validator instead of truthiness; pass the resulting notice and the user email into ProfileForm; delete the page-level notice slot and Card wrapper; update the :14-29 comment that says the page keeps the ?saved=1 confirmation.
files.why: The notice must be rendered where the refusal is known, otherwise the server-painted param outlives the inline refusal — and any non-empty param value must not render a notice.

files.change: Accept notice and email props; render the notice slot (same role/classes/markup, above the Card) followed by the Card containing the email line and the form; render the slot as null whenever state.status === 'error' so the saved notice never sits beside fresh field errors; idle renders, including the legacy ?error=invalid sentence, unchanged.
files.why: The island owns the refusal state, so it is the only place that can guarantee the saved notice never sits beside fresh field errors without moving the notice's position.

files.change: Add a closed-vocabulary profile-notice reader beside inviteNoticeText (saved==='1' -> 'Profile saved.', error==='invalid' -> PROFILE_REFUSAL_MESSAGE, error first, everything else null) for the profile page to read its params through.
files.why: ADR-0008 requires notice params read through a validator (absent, blank or unknown -> null); the profile page currently renders a notice for any non-empty value.

qa_script: Carry a balance in a live group, press Leave group and confirm: refusal names the blocker and offers Settle up; follow it to the debts section.
Archive the group and repeat the blocked leave: refusal shows with a read-only note and no Settle up link; settle to zero and leave from the archived group still succeeds.
Archive a solo-owner group and open its members screen at 375px and 1280px: no invite-sharing copy, no invite actions, only the archived seats note and read-only invite sentence.
Unarchived solo-owner group still shows the EmptyState with its working copy action; owner remove-with-balance path unchanged.
Save the profile (lands on ?saved=1), then submit an empty display name: inline field error shows, 'Profile saved.' is gone; refresh shows the saved notice again (accepted residual).
Load /profile?error=invalid directly: refusal sentence renders in the same slot as before; load /profile?saved=yes: nothing renders.
residual_risks: ?saved=1 stays in the URL: after a refusal, a refresh, back-then-forward, or returning from another page remounts a fresh island (idle state) and 'Profile saved.' reappears even though the last event was a refused save. Accepted: clearing it needs client navigation the plan deliberately avoids.
A balance blocked by a placeholder seat with no account has no remedy the Settle up link can offer; the link and the archived note do not cover that case.
The leave-link and removed-notice suppression conditions are not reachable from any static test seam (island-internal action state), so AC-1 and AC-4 rest on the browser walk alone.

docs/ui.md:220 describes the Members empty state as the invite-sharing prompt with no archived exception, and .sdlc/memory plus docs/spec, docs/prd, docs/trd, docs/ui are paths no ticket may change — so the archived exception this plan introduces cannot be doc'd where it belongs; the next review may re-file it as a missing-state finding.
A stale ?invite= notice from just before archiving can still render in the kept invite-notice slot; it is validated but not suppressed, unlike the removedNotice leave pairing.
risks: Findings 2 and 4 of the issue are duplicates of one defect; the plan fixes it once and AC-2 names both.
No server sentence changes, so lib/groups/actions.test.ts:850 (/settle up/i) stays green; the archived leave explanation is client-side copy only.
Moving the Card into the profile island changes the server/client boundary for the email line; idle markup is preserved but a screenshot diff of /profile?saved=1 should be eyeballed.
Hiding the archived invite actions removes the 22rem side card's interactive content; the read-only sentence keeps the column so the two-column balance at 1280px should be screenshotted.

cases: archived InvitePanel renders the read-only sentence with no invite input, Copy, Rotate or Disable controls
unarchived InvitePanel still renders the link, the join caption and the Rotate/Disable actions
archived solo-owner MembersScreen renders no 'Share the invite link' copy and keeps the archived seats note
unarchived solo-owner MembersScreen still renders the Nobody-else-here EmptyState with its action
idle ProfileForm with a saved notice renders the role=status slot before the Card, matching the current page markup
idle ProfileForm with the legacy error notice renders the refusal sentence in the same slot
idle ProfileForm with no notice renders no status slot (refusal-state suppression is browser-only)
profile notice validator accepts saved=1 and renders 'Profile saved.'
profile notice validator accepts error=invalid and renders the refusal sentence, error winning when both params present
profile notice validator returns null for forged, blank and unknown values (saved=yes, error=lol, absent)

validated_work_order.understanding: Issue #47 collects four non-blocking review findings from PR #44 for #37. Verified each against current code: (1) a leave blocked by a non-zero balance renders only <StateMessage> with no settle-up link while remove has one — still reproduces; (2)/(4) the archived solo-owner EmptyState still promises an invite link whose action returns null for archived groups — still reproduces, and these two findings are the same defect stated twice (same file, same render, same fix); (3) the ?saved=1 notice is server-rendered from searchParams while profile refusals return inline with no navigation, so the stale success sits beside fresh field errors — still reproduces. The critique added four verified gaps the plan now absorbs: the settle link would be a dead end on archived groups (leave is allowed there, settling is refused), the InvitePanel's link and Rotate/Disable controls are equally dead on archived groups, the profile notice read accepts any non-empty param value against ADR-0008, and the ?removed= notice has the same staleness mechanism in a file already touched. None was fixed by a later round.
